proof_0433.moves: Structural induction on the red-black node, with a three-way case split on the comparison result at each node; in each branch the ordering invariant for the rebuilt subtree is re-established from the inductive hypotheses.

proof_0434.moves: The right summand of an append is a sublist of the whole append (from reflexivity of Sublist), and well-formedness of a basis is inherited by sublists; apply the sublist lemma to that witness.

proof_0435.moves: Exhibit a colimit cocone: take the pushout cocone built from the existing pushout's injections, show it is a colimit using the epi-comp pushout-recognition lemma, then package it through HasColimit.mk'.

proof_0436.moves: Prove both directions of the iff: unfold semicontinuity as a neighbourhood condition on sublevel/superlevel sets, and convert between 'is a neighbourhood of each of its points' and openness using IsOpen.mem_nhds.

proof_0437.moves: Rewrite the bitvector of the USize coercion using the existing toBitVec_toUSize lemma, then push the resulting width cast through setWidth by congruence and close by reflexivity.

proof_0438.moves: Case analysis on the (impossible) derivation of n+1 <= 0: no constructor of Nat.le can produce it, so the goal is vacuously False. Nothing here is a citable lemma.

proof_0439.moves: Case analysis on the walk: non-nilness rules out the empty walk, so the walk ends in a cons and the required adjacency is exactly the edge stored there.

proof_0440.moves: Pure transport: substitute along the given equality of iterators (and the accompanying heterogeneous equality) and close by reflexivity. There is no mathematical content beyond congruence over the binders.

proof_0441.moves: Transfer the statement from the packaged hash map to the internal Raw0 representation (repackaging the raw map with its size invariant and using well-formedness) and apply the corresponding Raw0 lemma.

proof_0442.moves: Move both sides to the underlying bitvector via toBitVec_not and injectivity of toBitVec, then the statement is the bitvector-level commutation of complement across an equation.

proof_0443.moves: Definitional unfolding only: the X2 component of the short complex sc1 is by construction the stated object, so the proof is rfl.

proof_0444.moves: Push the nonnegative-real distance to the real distance via the injective coercion, then apply dist_eq_zero, which is where the genuine MetricSpace (not merely pseudometric) hypothesis is used.

proof_0445.moves: Unfold the Int8 order relations to the corresponding order on the underlying integers via toInt, then apply transitivity of < with <= on Int.

proof_0446.moves: Unfold deleteVerts as the subgraph induced on the set difference, apply induce_adj, and rewrite membership in a set difference as membership plus non-membership.

proof_0447.moves: Use the criterion for two drops of the same list to agree, which reduces the goal to the arithmetic identity min n len = min (min n len) len, discharged by associativity of min plus min_eq_left with the trivial <= .

proof_0448.moves: Transfer to the bitvector level via toBitVec_not and use that a bitvector of positive width never equals its own complement; positivity of the platform word size is the side condition.

proof_0449.moves: The extended norm is by definition the ENNReal coercion of the nonnegative norm, so the inequality is a coercion of an inequality in NNReal; conclude by order-reflection of that coercion.

proof_0450.moves: Transfer the statement to the internal Raw0 representation (repackaging the raw map with its size invariant, using well-formedness) and apply the corresponding Raw0 lemma about getD when contains is false.

proof_0451.moves: Rewrite prev in terms of the posLT description (valid because the position is not the start), then apply the characterisation of <= against posLT to land on the strict inequality.

proof_0452.moves: Contrapose the iff, then combine 'a Finset is not nonempty iff it is empty' with 'the support is empty iff the element is zero'.

proof_0453.moves: Definitional: the unit of the trivial group object is by construction the identity of the tensor unit, so the proof is rfl.

proof_0454.moves: A continuous affine map is differentiable everywhere (already proved), and global differentiability restricts to differentiability on any set.

proof_0455.moves: Definitional: the circular-order structure on Fin is defined so that sbtw unfolds directly to the stated condition, so the iff is Iff.rfl.

proof_0456.moves: In a preorder viewed as a category, every object has exactly one morphism to the top element (it exists since x <= top, and hom-sets are subsingletons), so top is terminal by the uniqueness criterion.
